listingTitle: Compile constant C# regexes outside loops
title: Compile constant C# regexes outside loops
why: Constructing Regex from a constant pattern during every iteration repeats allocation and can repeat compilation work.
suggestion: Create and reuse a Regex before the loop, or use a generated regex where the target framework supports it.
limitations: Only direct Regex construction from a normal or verbatim string literal in a multiline loop body is reported.
Aliases, wrapper constructors, generated regex methods, interpolated patterns, and dynamic patterns are not inferred.
